accessToken.description: A generated access token. Only available on creation.

creator.description: The user who created the access token.

description.description: The description of the access token.

displayName.description: The displayed name of the access token.

expires.description: Indicates if the access token can expire.

id.description: An auto generated unique id which identifies the access token.

validUntil.description: The date and time util an access token is valid to (inclusively).

permissions.description: The access permissions granted to the access token or access policy.
